statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit. The requested host redirects to https://www.filmyzilla47.com/.

page.notes: Public movie catalogue. The requested .43 host permanently redirects to .47.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshot and CSS feature probe under dark preference
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-preference screenshot is pixel-identical to the light mobile capture; body remains white, color-scheme is normal, and no prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() rule exists.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature probe and reduced-motion emulation
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no running content animation on the home path, and its stylesheet contains a prefers-reduced-motion rule; reduced-motion emulation did not introduce unavoidable motion.

checkOutcomes.method: High-contrast emulation plus Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No prefers-contrast or forced-colors rule exists, and Lighthouse found multiple text contrast failures, including 3.62:1 white text on the blue section bar.

checkOutcomes.method: Route walkthrough and CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, category, and detail navigation are abrupt full-document swaps; CSS contains no view-transition rules.
No scroll-linked visual effect or custom scroll animation is present, so the page does not use main-thread scroll listeners for motion.
The inspected experience uses native document scrolling and ordinary links; no custom pointer gesture implementation fights platform scrolling.
There is no sticky or affixed chrome whose state needs to react to scrolling.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no sticky or affixed chrome whose state needs to react to scrolling.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, popover, or floating menu is present on the representative templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, or floating menu is present on the representative templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Category and detail pages provide visible breadcrumbs, blue section headings, and related-content grouping that preserve location and next-step context.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshots at desktop and mobile
checkOutcomes.evidence: No pop-up, consent wall, interstitial, or content-obscuring banner appeared on load.
No disclosure, modal, transient overlay, or custom rich control is present.
checkOutcomes.reason: No disclosure, modal, transient overlay, or custom rich control is present.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The templates have very little application chrome and devote nearly all vertical space to content and links.
The mobile layout reports scrollWidth 360px, innerWidth 360px, and 0px horizontal overflow; all representative templates fit the viewport.
Cards and text use intrinsic full-width flow and adapt cleanly at 360px; no component is reused in independently sized containers where a container query is needed.

checkOutcomes.method: Keyboard focus and target geometry probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Keyboard focus uses a visible browser outline, but many primary text links are only about 15px high, far below a comfortable touch target.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport review on home, listing, and detail templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home viewport puts duplicated keyword-heavy introductory copy before the useful catalogue, while category/detail pages communicate their purpose clearly.

checkOutcomes.method: Home to category to detail walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative browse flow reaches a category, a movie detail, and clearly labelled format/size links without an account wall or hidden prerequisite; binary download was not opened for safety.
A deliberately invalid path silently redirects to the homepage with no 404 explanation, retry guidance, or preserved failed URL.
Lighthouse mobile LCP was 2.593s, narrowly outside the good <=2.5s range; CLS was 0 and TBT 0ms. The raw-CDP trace measured LCP 1.411s, showing network-condition sensitivity.
Both the layout primitive and Lighthouse measured CLS 0 with no observed shift entries.
The trace and layout observer found zero long tasks and 0ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary, DOM confirmation, and Lighthouse insights
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial host adds a 301 redirect; two parser-inserted stylesheets are VeryHigh priority and Lighthouse estimates 970ms render-blocking savings and 810ms redirect savings.
Lighthouse reports about 18KiB of unused CSS; Font Awesome is the largest resource at 19,378 transferred bytes on a visually simple page.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse/DOM inspection across forms and images
checkOutcomes.evidence: The category and detail search forms use placeholder text without an associated label, and the jump-to-page text input is likewise unlabelled; home image alt coverage otherwise passes Lighthouse.
Lighthouse found multiple WCAG contrast failures, including 4.09:1 at 11px, 4.06:1 blue links at 11px, and 3.62:1 section heading text.

checkOutcomes.method: Landmark/heading probe and keyboard focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no main landmark, has two H1 elements plus an empty H3, and relies only on the browser focus outline. Lighthouse explicitly failed the main-landmark audit.
Body copy is predominantly 11.2-12px and dense, with long keyword-heavy paragraphs that are difficult to scan on a 360px viewport.

checkOutcomes.method: Viewport audit, mobile reflow, and target geometry
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page reflows without horizontal overflow, but meta viewport sets user-scalable=no and many links are approximately 15px high; Lighthouse fails the viewport zoom audit.
Lighthouse errors-in-console scored 1 with no logged browser errors.
Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but 21 of 25 home images lack explicit dimensions and authored markup uses obsolete font elements extensively.
Lighthouse best-practices is 0.73 and reports a DevTools cookie issue from Statcounter; the page also disables zoom through viewport policy.
Home, category, and detail templates expose unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML, link probe, robots, and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: All 165 sampled home links have href values, viewport metadata is present, robots permits search, and Lighthouse SEO scores 1.0.

checkOutcomes.method: Canonical, robots, sitemap, and response inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The final host returns index/follow pages with matching canonical URLs; robots.txt is reachable and sitemap.xml is populated.
The movie detail has title and Open Graph text, but no og:image and no JSON-LD/schema.org entity for the visible movie.
HTTPS is used and no exposed secret was found, but CSP, HSTS, and X-Content-Type-Options are all absent.
The page contacts six third-party origins and loads Google Tag Manager, Histats, and Statcounter; Lighthouse observed two third-party Statcounter cookies.
No permission request or authentication flow exists on the representative public catalogue paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No permission request or authentication flow exists on the representative public catalogue paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP frame-ancestors, or HSTS header is present.
Raw HTML contains 100% of rendered content tokens, including title, H1, and description; this is not a JavaScript shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative path DOM and visual inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The MPA uses ordinary links and static content; no overlay, fragile async component, or clipped floating menu appeared on tested templates.
This is a public content catalogue rather than an app-like installed experience; offline installation is not necessary to complete the browse task.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a public content catalogue rather than an app-like installed experience; offline installation is not necessary to complete the browse task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: An invalid route silently redirects to the homepage instead of preserving an explicit not-found state with recovery options.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang=en is present, but dir is absent and CSS uses physical left/right positioning with no logical-property usage despite multilingual movie content.
The detail template renders a fixed English date such as “17 Jul 2026”; no Intl usage or locale selection is present.
The tested pages contain release dates but no event times, deadlines, recurrences, or time-zone-sensitive state.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested pages contain release dates but no event times, deadlines, recurrences, or time-zone-sensitive state.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual walkthrough of browse and download-choice surfaces
checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested pages show file formats and sizes directly, have no forced continuity, account wall, upsell, or confirmshaming, and include a visible DMCA path.
Search and jump forms have no visible instructions or associated labels, and the invalid-route experience gives no explicit error or recovery message.
Only site search and page-jump fields are present; there are no address, payment, sign-in, or sign-up fields needing identity/autofill tokens.
checkOutcomes.reason: Only site search and page-jump fields are present; there are no address, payment, sign-in, or sign-up fields needing identity/autofill tokens.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, or account-management flow appears in the representative pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, consent, authentication, or account-management flow appears in the representative pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: All 25 home images use legacy PNG/GIF formats, 21 lack dimensions, and 20 below-fold icons are not lazy loaded, although total image transfer is only 4,991 bytes.
The page transfers only 58,489 bytes in 14 requests and produces no long tasks or continuing media work.
Tracking and utility third parties dominate the tiny page: Statcounter and Font Awesome alone transfer about 37KiB, while six third-party origins are contacted.

checkOutcomes.method: Site intent and DOM capability inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site exposes static public content and ordinary links but no transactional or productivity capability that needs WebMCP tooling.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site exposes static public content and ordinary links but no transactional or productivity capability that needs WebMCP tooling.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model feature is part of the user experience, and adding one is not necessary to complete the browse task.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model feature is part of the user experience, and adding one is not necessary to complete the browse task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The site is a static multi-page catalogue whose navigation reloads the document; there is no long-lived modal, SPA route, editor, or feed interaction to repeat meaningfully.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site is a static multi-page catalogue whose navigation reloads the document; there is no long-lived modal, SPA route, editor, or feed interaction to repeat meaningfully.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The home heap contains 76,927 nodes with 3,779,636 bytes total self size, proportionate for the rendered page and its browser/runtime state.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap constructor summary and static runtime inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The single-state heap summary shows no Detached* constructor among retained populations, and the static MPA has no repeating client-render lifecycle.

principleOutcomes.reason: The site exposes static public content and ordinary links but no transactional or productivity capability that needs WebMCP tooling. No summarisation or language-model feature is part of the user experience, and adding one is not necessary to complete the browse task.

paths.description: Entry page and homepage template; tested desktop/mobile, user preferences, no-JS, performance, network, security, privacy, accessibility, images, and memory.
Representative category/listing template with search, cards, pagination, sorting, and breadcrumbs.
Representative movie detail template and browse flow endpoint; format/size choices inspected without opening untrusted binary downloads.
Invalid-route recovery behavior; distinct error-state archetype.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: Dark emulation leaves the light palette unchanged; body remains white and CSS has no dark-theme feature.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven surface/text colors.

findings.summary: Contrast preferences and baseline contrast are not robust
findings.evidence: No forced-colors/prefers-contrast handling exists, and Lighthouse found several WCAG contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise contrast ratios and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations for essential UI.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: The representative MPA journey uses full-document swaps without cross-document View Transitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } with reduced-motion-safe enhancements.

findings.summary: Primary links have undersized touch targets
findings.evidence: Geometry sampling shows many catalogue links are only about 15px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase line-height and block padding so tap targets are at least about 44px without crowding.

findings.summary: Useful catalogue content is buried under repetitive copy
findings.evidence: The mobile homepage spends most of the first viewport on duplicate, keyword-heavy introductory text before latest titles.
findings.suggestedFix: Lead with a concise purpose statement, search, and latest/category actions; move supporting prose below.

findings.summary: Invalid URLs silently redirect home
findings.evidence: The invalid-route test ends at the homepage with no not-found message or recovery context.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 page with search, home, and relevant-category recovery links.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP narrowly misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 2.593s while trace under another run measured 1.411s.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the legacy-host redirect and prioritize the first render to keep LCP consistently <=2.5s.

findings.summary: Redirect and render-blocking CSS delay first content
findings.evidence: HAR and Lighthouse show an 810ms redirect opportunity and about 970ms render-blocking opportunity.
findings.suggestedFix: Link directly to the canonical host and inline/split critical CSS; load noncritical styles later.

findings.summary: Most of the Font Awesome stylesheet is unused
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 18KiB unused CSS; the 19,378-byte Font Awesome file is the largest request.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the icon font with the few inline SVGs needed or subset the stylesheet.

findings.summary: Search and page-jump fields lack labels
findings.evidence: Category/detail HTML uses placeholders or nearby text but no associated label elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Add explicit label elements and appropriate search input semantics.

findings.summary: Small text and links fail contrast requirements
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports multiple failures from 3.62:1 to 4.09:1 at 11-12px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use darker link/green/red colors or larger type so all text meets WCAG AA.

findings.summary: Document structure lacks a main landmark
findings.evidence: The home has two H1s, an empty H3, and no main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main and establish one descriptive H1 with sequential section headings.

findings.summary: Text is too small and dense on mobile
findings.evidence: Computed styles and screenshots show 11.2-12px body text in long unstructured paragraphs.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a fluid base near 16px, comfortable line-height/measure, and concise sections or lists.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and tap targets are cramped
findings.evidence: meta viewport contains user-scalable=no and many links are around 15px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and enlarge interactive targets while retaining current reflow.

findings.summary: Markup and image sizing are dated
findings.evidence: Twenty-one images lack dimensions and obsolete font elements are used throughout.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height or aspect-ratio and replace font tags with semantic HTML/CSS.

findings.summary: Third-party cookie behavior triggers browser issues
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices is 0.73 and DevTools logs a Statcounter cookie issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove Statcounter or configure a privacy-preserving, standards-compliant analytics setup.

findings.summary: Movie pages lack rich entity and preview imagery
findings.evidence: The detail page has no JSON-LD and no og:image despite showing a movie poster and metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit accurate schema.org Movie JSON-LD and og:image/Twitter image metadata.

findings.summary: Core transport security headers are absent
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no CSP, HSTS, or X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, and nosniff header after testing required origins.

findings.summary: Multiple trackers collect data by default
findings.evidence: Six third-party origins include GTM, Histats, and Statcounter; Lighthouse observed two third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant trackers, minimize analytics, and gate nonessential collection on informed choice.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are missing
findings.evidence: No frame defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP, or HSTS is returned.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies, CSP, and HSTS.

findings.summary: Network/HTTP failure state is misleading
findings.evidence: A nonexistent path silently becomes a successful homepage instead of a recoverable 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Return an honest 404 status and useful recovery UI.

findings.summary: Layout is not prepared for writing-direction changes
findings.evidence: CSS uses physical left/right placement and no logical properties; dir is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction appropriately and migrate spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Release dates are fixed to one English format
findings.evidence: The detail page prints “17 Jul 2026” and no Intl formatting is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Store an unambiguous date and format it with Intl.DateTimeFormat for the active locale.

findings.summary: Forms and invalid routes provide weak recovery guidance
findings.evidence: Search/jump inputs lack labels and invalid navigation has no explicit message.
findings.suggestedFix: Label fields, validate page jumps after interaction, and show actionable recovery text.

findings.summary: Asset delivery uses only legacy image formats
findings.evidence: All 25 home images are PNG/GIF, 21 lack dimensions, and below-fold icons are not lazy loaded, though bytes are small.
findings.suggestedFix: Use SVG/WebP/AVIF where useful, add dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold noncritical imagery.

findings.summary: Third-party code is disproportionate to the page
findings.evidence: Statcounter plus Font Awesome account for about 37KiB of a 58KiB transfer and six third-party origins are contacted.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant analytics and replace the icon library with local minimal SVGs.
